description: Get ready in a New York minute with Balm Dotcom, Boy Brow, Cloud Paint Plush Blush and Lip Line. Four makeup must-haves for a seamless look you can put together while on the subway or in the back of a moving cab.

New Boy Brow Arch shapes and defines brows with a 2-in-1 custom tip shape— a precision edge for hair-like flicks and flat edge to fill sparse areas. Pair with our legendary face-framing Boy Brow for flexible hold + a total brow look.
Build the ultimate combo with Lip Line, our enhancing lip pencil, and Ultralip, our high-shine lipstick for a hint of moisturizing color.

A perfect duo curated for a dewy glow. Apply our oil-serum hybrid, Futuredew, for a lit-from-within glow, then top off your look with Cloud Paint, our seamless, gel-cream cheek color, for a natural-looking flush or sun-hugged definition.

Two makeup icons for natural coverage. Start by applying with our ultra-thin, breathable Perfecting Skin Tint all over the face and spot correct with our buildable Stretch Balm Concealer. The result? A glowy, looks-like-you base that feels like you’ve got nothing on.
Pucker up to this limited edition lip combo. Start by lining your lips with our seamless enhancing pencil, Lip Line, and finish off the look with a few swipes of our nourishing Balm Dotcom.
Choose your own adventure with 2 Cloud Paints of your choice. Wear them alone or tap into your inner artist and mix or layer together for a custom look.

Your shortcut to looking like the best version of yourself. The No-Makeup Makeup Kit pairs three everyday icons: Lash Slick for long, defined lashes that won’t budge, Boy Brow for soft, fluffy brows with flexible hold, and Stretch Balm Concealer for medium, dewy coverage wherever you want it. Together, they create a fresh-faced look that enhances, never hides.

Three steps, every day. Start and end the day with our conditioning face wash, Milky Jelly Cleanser. Lock in moisture with our cocooning recovery cream, After Baume. And keep your skin protected from the sun with our lightweight SPF50 Invisible Shield sunscreen.

Your dog is already the cutest one at the park. Might as well dress the part. This walk-ready set includes our limited-edition You Look Good Leash, You Look Good Collar, Smile Wave Pet Waste Bags, plus a matching dispenser (already stocked with a roll) for serving looks from first lap to final potty break.

Every good walk starts with the essentials. This walk-ready duo pairs our Pet Waste Bag Dispenser—already pre-packed with one roll of bags—with an additional eight unscented rolls of Smile Wave Pet Waste Bags, so you’re always prepared for whatever the sidewalk throws your way. Cute, convenient and deeply appreciated by your neighborhood.
